services: Construction & infrastructure: differing site conditions / REAs
Bonding & certified payroll on large awards
final_text:
Hello Jeff,

I hope you are having a great week. My name is Marcos Gonzalez and I am the Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal, a D.C.-based government contracting law firm. I wanted to congratulate you on the Skagway River levee repair award from the Army Corps. Getting the town's flood protection rebuilt after the 2022 damage is important work. This is also exactly the kind of job where subsurface conditions may be different than the plans showed. When that happens, a well-documented request for equitable adjustment can protect your schedule and your margin. GovSpring also helps contractors keep their bonding and certified-payroll requirements clean on awards this size, so a contracting officer's questions never slow you down.

I would love to connect briefly to introduce myself and see how we might support Hamilton Construction on this and other projects. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and my law clerks, who would also participate in any scheduled call.

Best,
